# Wai Wireless Asia

> Cable-free desk gear, delivered across Singapore. An online shop in Singapore selling six desk products and nothing else.

## Products and prices (SGD)
- Wireless charging pad: S$39. 10 cm round pad, 15 W, one USB-C lead off the back.
- 3-in-1 charging stand: S$89. Phone, earbud case and watch on one 18 cm base.
- Rechargeable desk lamp: S$69. Battery lamp, three colour temperatures, touch dimmer.
- Desk speaker: S$79. 16 cm fabric-front speaker, about ten hours a charge.
- Cable organiser kit: S$19. 40 cm under-desk cable tray, six clips, ten ties.
- Felt desk mat: S$35. 80 x 40 cm wool-blend felt, 4 mm thick.

Phone contracts, device fixing, second-hand goods, delivery outside Singapore.
